top news.title: John Jumper, who won the Nobel Prize “for protein structure prediction”, says he is leaving Google DeepMind after nearly nine years to join Anthropic

tweets.author: @demishassabis
tweets.text: Thanks John for an extraordinary partnership and wonderful collaboration over the past 9 years! What we achieved with AlphaFold changed the world, and showed the field what was possible with AI for science and medicine, lighting the way for how AI can benefit humanity.

tweets.author: @nc_frey
tweets.text: excited to welcome @JohnJumperSci to @AnthropicAI ! John's work on AlphaFold opened the door for me and many other recovering physicists to contribute to this field. we need many more “AlphaFold moments” in AI x Bio and I'm stoked to have John on board

tweets.author: @yuchenj_uw
tweets.text: John Jumper is a Nobel laureate who won the 2024 Nobel Prize with Demis Hassabis. Now he's leaving Google DeepMind too, right after Noam Shazeer. What is going on at Google DeepMind? I had really high hopes for Gemini.

sub_items.title: The departure of John Jumper, a key member of Google's AI coding development team, further strains Google's efforts to compete with Anthropic and OpenAI

top news.title: Sources: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick questioned ASML leaders on concerns China acquired one of its EUV machines, violating US-led export restrictions

tweets.author: @kyleichan
tweets.text: The US government is accusing ASML of letting China get an EUV lithography machine. This seems bizarre to me, and no evidence was provided. ASML has pushed back, saying they can track where every EUV machine in the world is and that each one requires constant servicing by ASML.

tweets.author: @maartendik
tweets.text: $ASML What a bizarre thing to say. Especially with new machines. Next to export licenses, EUV machines require maintenance. It is very, very hard if not impossible to lose track of these machines in working conditions.

tweets.author: @bgmasters
tweets.text: ASML's “we have never shipped an EUV machine to China” is telling on itself. Total lawyer answer. They know a decommissioned machine slipped through, at tremendous cost to American national security. [image]

sub_items.title: ASML says claims that one of its EUV lithography systems has ended up in China are inaccurate, after a report on Howard Lutnick's questions to ASML's leadership

top news.title: Trump says he saw Anthropic last week as a national security threat, but signals relations have since improved because Dario Amodei was “nice” and “smart” at G7

tweets.author: @andrewcurran_
tweets.text: Axios: ‘Do you view Anthropic, and to a degree its CEO Dario Amodei, as a threat to national security?’  President Trump: 'Well, not now, but a week ago maybe.  I was with him yesterday.  He made a speech.  I made a little speech.  We were in the room on the G7, and seems like a nice guy, smart guy.  But he responded to us very quickly.  Because you know it's tremendous liability.  People get put in prison immediately for that.  You know.  You can't play games with that.  And he responded very responsibly, I thought.  So far.  I think he will.'

tweets.author: @juddrosenblatt
tweets.text: Remarkable how much more maturity, pragmatism, and agency Trump shows here than the caricature most in “AI Safety” hold of him
